Synapse, Matrix Authentication Service, Element Web and Ketesa move forward, and authlib is pinned to a version without the open advisories.

## ✨ Added

- **Synapse [v1.164.1](https://github.com/element-hq/synapse/releases/tag/v1.164.1).**
- **Matrix Authentication Service [1.28.0](https://github.com/element-hq/matrix-authentication-service/releases/tag/v1.28.0).** Only reached when Delegated Auth is switched on.
- **Element Web [v1.12.33](https://github.com/element-hq/element-web/releases/tag/v1.12.33).**
- **Ketesa [v1.5.2](https://github.com/etkecc/ketesa/releases/tag/v1.5.2).**
- **A compose file for other Docker hosts.** `compose.yaml` runs Matrix on any Linux server with Docker, and the README says how to use it on Synology, Proxmox and MOS.

## 🎨 Design

- **A MOS button in the README** takes the place of the Docker Hub button, next to the compose file and the source.

## ⚡ Improved

- **gosu 1.20.**

## 🐛 Fixed

- **authlib 1.9.1 instead of the version Synapse 1.164.1 ships.** That fixes eight advisories, one of them critical. The pin goes once a Synapse release brings 1.9.1 itself.
